name: ibanforge
description: Check the bank behind an IBAN before you pay: validation in 89 countries, a bank-code verdict from the national register (DE, AT, BE, SK, BG, CH, LI), the bank and BIC with their source, SEPA and VoP readiness from the EPC registers where they list the bank, and bank-level sanctions (OFAC, EU, UN).

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Validate one IBAN and enrich it with the issuing bank, BIC, EMI/vIBAN class, SEPA + VoP reachability, risk indicators and Swiss BC-Nummer. Cost: $0.005 USDC.

tools.name: batch_validate_iban
tools.description: Validate up to 100 IBANs in one call, with the same enrichment as a single validation. Cost: $0.002 USDC per IBAN (e.g. 100 IBANs = $0.20).

tools.name: lookup_bic
tools.description: Resolve a BIC/SWIFT code into the institution behind it: legal name, country, city, LEI and registered address where published. Cost: $0.003 USDC.

bic.description: BIC code (8 or 11 characters, e.g., UBSWCHZH80A)

tools.name: check_compliance
tools.description: Pre-flight compliance triage on an IBAN or a BIC: bank-level sanctions screening, FATF jurisdiction flag, SEPA Instant reachability, VoP participation and a 0-100 risk score. Cost: $0.02 USDC.

bic.description: BIC to check instead of an IBAN (never both)

tools.name: lookup_ch_clearing
tools.description: Resolve a Swiss BC-Nummer / IID into the institution, its seat address, its BIC and its full payment-rail participation including QR-IID. Cost: $0.003 USDC.

iid.description: Swiss IID / BC-Nummer (1-5 digits, e.g., 230 for UBS Switzerland)

tools.name: validate_payment_reference
tools.description: Check a structured payment reference (RF/ISO 11649, Swiss QRR, Belgian OGM/VCS, Finnish viitenumero) against the dated document that publishes its rule. Cost: free.

reference.description: The structured reference (RF/ISO 11649, Swiss QRR, Belgian OGM/VCS, Finnish viitenumero)

iban.description: Optional IBAN, to also get the QRR/QR-IBAN pairing verdict

tools.name: check_postal_address
tools.description: Check a structured ISO 20022 postal address against one payment rail's published rules (sps, hvps_plus or fedwire), each finding citing its source document. Cost: free.

scheme.description: The payment rail whose published address rules to apply

address.description: ISO 20022 PostalAddress in snake_cased tags: strt_nm, bldg_nb, pst_cd, twn_nm, ctry, adr_line

tools.name: check_swiss_qr_bill
tools.description: Check a Swiss QR-bill payload (the SPC text inside the QR code): header, creditor IBAN and QR-IBAN range, QRR/SCOR/NON reference checksums and pairing, amount, currency, and whether the addresses are structured (type S) or still combined (type K), with a proposed structured form. Cost: free.

payload.description: The Swiss QR Code text with real line breaks (SPC ... EPD).

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Report incorrect data or claim an x402 refund, without opening an account. Cost: free.

error_type.description: What kind of problem is being reported

message.description: What is wrong, in plain words

tools.name: request_api_key
tools.description: Open a key request a human approves in a browser, with no e-mail address and no account. Show the code and the link to your human, then call poll_api_key. Cost: free.

client_name.description: Who is asking, shown to the human on the approval page

reason.description: What the key is for, shown to the human on the approval page

tools.name: poll_api_key
tools.description: Collect the key once a human has approved the request opened by request_api_key. Handed over exactly once, with the config line to paste. Cost: free.

device_code.description: Leave empty to reuse the last request from this session
